CRIM 545 Project 2

Raneem Sayyad

13 October 2025

MAP 1

Reported sex abuse incidents are most concentrated in central DC, especially around Downtown, Adams Morgan, and Capitol Hill. The darker shading in these areas shows higher report levels. Moderate activity extends north through Columbia Heights and Dupont Circle. Several cold spots appear across the city, including Chevy Chase, Palisades, and Spring Valley. The far east and south areas, such as Blue Plains and Bellevue, also show low incident density and clear cold spots.

MAP 2

Motor vehicle theft is most common in Central and Northeast DC, with strong concentrations around Adams Morgan, Logan Circle, and Trinidad. Elevated activity also appears in parts of Columbia Heights. Many cold spots for motor vehicle theft are spread across the city, including Brightwood, Cleveland Park, Tenleytown, and Friendship Heights.

MAP 3

Arson incidents are mainly clustered in Southeast and Central DC, with the largest group near Anacostia and Barry Farm (364 incidents). A smaller cluster is found in Central DC with 18 incidents. Cold spots appear in areas like Brookland, Capitol Hill, and Glover Park, where no major clusters are present. These neighborhoods fall outside the main zones of arson activity.
